paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah ben Gamda (a Tanna): Sotah 43b.
Rabbi Chiyya bar Gamda: Hyman cites Shabbat 50a.

notes.text: The Sotah 43b passage is supported by the saved William Davidson digital text. The additional Shabbat 50a citation for Chiyya bar Gamda remains unlocated in the returned review, with no matching named evidence supplied for it; that citation remains open.

The printed Gamda entry cites Shabbat 50a, where the consulted text names Rabbi Asi ben Shaul. In his separate entry on Chiyya, Hyman cites 50a for that form of Asi’s name and Shabbat 3a for Chiyya himself. At 3a, Rabbi Chiyya bar Gamda reports a teaching about two people performing a prohibited labor together.
